Gilded Route and Resources

[[img:icon_caravan_cargo]][[/img]] [[col:green]]Send trade convoys across the world via the[[/col]] [[url:script_link_campaign_ivory_road]][[tooltip:{{tt:tooltip_campaign_ivory_road}}]]Gilded Route[[/tooltip]][[/url]][[col:green]]. Every type of[[/col]] [[col:yellow]]resource building[[/col]] [[col:green]]you hold raises the sale value of cargo and brings extra income.[[/col]]
Poaching Contracts

[[img:icon_ogr_contracts]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Poach[[/col]] [[col:green]]the riches of other factions through contracts: lead an army into their resource regions for gold, at the cost of their goodwill. Generals who see it through gain experience, the faction leader three times as much.[[/col]]
Sea, Not Soil

[[img:icon_port]][[/img]] [[col:green]]Ports yield double income, and settlements in Ancient Elven Colonies boost sea trade.[[/col]] [[col:red]]Main settlements cost twice their income in upkeep, industry buildings are forbidden and armies cost more to maintain.[[/col]]
Vassals and Climate

[[img:icon_vassal]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Hold[[/col]] [[col:green]]only what is worth holding, and hand the rest to[[/col]] [[col:yellow]]vassals[[/col]][[col:green]]. The de Roelefs can settle in any climate.[[/col]]
The Council of Wavemasters

[[img:icon_vassal]][[/img]] [[col:green]]No single lord rules the clan. The Council of Wavemasters elects a new[[/col]] [[col:yellow]]First Wavemaster[[/col]] [[col:green]]at regular intervals, and faction-wide effects follow the result of each election.[[/col]]
Council Factions

[[img:icon_supporters]][[/img]] [[col:green]]Mages, Admirals and Merchants vie for[[/col]] [[col:yellow]]standing in the Council[[/col]][[col:green]]. Raise their standing to steer who wins the next election.[[/col]]
Hard Bargains

[[img:icon_trade_agreement]][[/img]] [[col:green]]When a trade agreement is signed, the Council decides its terms:[[/col]] [[col:yellow]]fair, harsh, or with a hidden clause[[/col]][[col:green]].[[/col]]
